title: ZSDK Integration Guide Using React Native

blocks.text: This guide provides steps on how to integrate ZSDK into your Android and iOS applications using the React Native framework. React Native developers can leverage ZSDK capabilities without the need to write native code.

blocks.item: For Android:
You're running Android 9 or later (i.e., minimum API Level 28).
Your Android application works on both 32-bit and 64-bit devices that are ARM-based (i.e., armeabi-v7a or arm64-v8a).
For iOS, your application is running on iOS 15 or later.

blocks.text: To manually integrate ZSDK into the React Native framework:

blocks.item: Enter this command in your terminal to fetch the download link:
```bash curl -H "Authorization: Bearer GITHUB_TOKEN" https://npm.pkg.github.com/@zscaler%2fzscalersdk-reactnative ```
From the JSON response, find the key name tarball, where you will find the version and value for the URL.
Create a URL with the version and value from the key name tarball so that you can use them as the TARBALL-URL.
Example: https://npm.pkg.github.com/download/@zscaler/zscalersdk-reactnative/1.1.0/6a4fafff01275de02dbb807c5652bec5853ee91d
Download the package by entering the following command:
```bash curl -L -H "Authorization: Bearer GITHUB_TOKEN" <TARBALL-URL> -o /path/to/save/tar/gz/zscalersdk-reactnative.tar.gz ```
Run the following command from the root folder of your project:
```bash npm install /path/to/save/tar/gz/zscalersdk-reactnative.tar.gz ```

blocks.text: After manually integrating ZSDK, you can start a ZSDK installation setup on your Android or iOS platform.
As an alternative to manually integrating ZSDK, you can opt to install an NPM package. To learn more, refer to GitHub Documentation - Installing a Package.
If you choose the alternative integration, you can specify the version according to your requirements by entering this code in the package.json file:
For ZSDK installation on Android devices, you need to enable Gradle to retrieve the Zscaler SDK for Mobile Apps - Android from GitHub:

blocks.item: Add the maven repository configuration to your android/build.gradle file.

``` bash allprojects { repositories { maven { name = "ZscalerSDKAndroid" url = uri("https://maven.pkg.github.com/zscaler/zscaler-sdk-android") credentials { username = settings.extra.get("gpr.user") as String ?: System.getenv("GITHUB_USERNAME") password = settings.extra.get("gpr.key") as String ?: System.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN") } } } } ```
Gradle can now resolve and download ZSDK during dependency installation.
Run the following command from the Android folder:
``` bash ./gradlew generateCodegenArtifactsFromSchema ```

blocks.text: ZSDK installation for Android is complete.
For ZSDK installation on iOS devices, you must enable CocoaPods to retrieve the Zscaler SDK for Mobile Apps - iOS from GitHub:

blocks.item: In your PodFile, enter the following command:

```rb ws_dir = Pathname.new(__dir__) zscaler_sdk_pod_file = Pathname.new(ws_dir).join('../node_modules/@zscaler/zscalersdk-reactnative/ios/ZscalerSDK_pod_setup.rb') require zscaler_sdk_pod_file configure_zscalersdk_pod ```
CocoaPods can resolve and download ZSDK during the dependency installation.
Enter the following command to start ZSDK installation:
```bash pod install ```

blocks.text: ZSDK installation for iOS is complete.
